I already incorporated it into Agent Zero using the API and it can work for an hour non stop if given a proper prompt and harness, does not make any mistakes that I've seen so far - I'm using it in a test repo so far. And yes, it's cheap. 

Although I'm not going to lie and join the bandwagon here because Sol 5.6 ULTRA and Fable still have their places, and yes even all three would make quite a team, as Fable the product manager, Sol 5.6 the orchestrator using DeepSeek V4 flash as subagents team of engineers.

But yeah, this is a HUGE win for open weights because nobody wants to pay for Fable and Sol 5.6 is literally only useful on a 20x plan.
